description: Stinkshot (current main and the build the first benchmark measured) vs ShareX vs Greenshot vs Flameshot, re-run with the overlay-ready metric. See README.md for method, definitions and caveats.

notes.overlay_ready: ready_ms = start of the final unbroken stretch in which an overlay window of the tool is visible, uncloaked, covers >= 95% of a monitor and has the rect it still has 600 ms after it first became visible. visible_ms = first such window at any size. settled_ms = last rect change (the first run's metric; ignores hide/re-show).
notes.slow_runs: runs more than 150 ms above the tool's median ready_ms
notes.display_state: console display state was 0 (off, idle timeout) for the whole run, see run.log
notes.stinkshot_before: stinkshot-before = commit 3d3c876 (the code the first benchmark measured, docs-only after 6e1485e), profile benchbefore, run in the same session

overlay_frozen.stinkshot: not measurable: overlay window uses WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE (crates/app/src/overlay/mod.rs), so screen-DC and duplication reads see through it; freeze_screen=true by config
overlay_frozen.sharex: frozen (animated swatch constant through the overlay; red patch dimmed 255 -> 204)
overlay_frozen.flameshot: n/a: the region command shows a monitor picker on this mixed-DPI setup; the capture overlay itself was never reached (needs a click or key)

notes.display_affinity_field: GetWindowDisplayAffinity on another process's window returned 0 for all tools; the field in raw samples is not meaningful
